items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he came down from Scarsdale with the Dick- Bob Wilburn -- Those guys, yeah, Bob Wilburn (inaudible). [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and Dick Wellstood and all of them.

ctx.x: Well, the director's scale, you know, I'll get probable double -- I'll get double for the -- and what the men get. So anyway, I took it. And we needed a piano player. See, we had -- we had Dick Vance and myself. I got Dick Vance, and we had a little drummer named Kenny --
oh -- he came here with Dick Wellstood Wilsted. Strong, Den Strong -- Dennis Strong. I don't know if you ever heard, but he came down from Scarsdale with the Dick- Bob Wilburn --
